goal: One self-hosted fully open-source enterprise calendar, native Authentik, organizations/teams/roles/scoped APIs, team scheduling, audit/reminders, routing/reporting and repeatable community updates.

native_tracker.migration_plan_result: Installed reviewed migration supports only 13..16 to 17; source 5 rejected. No unsupported migration or reset performed.

tracking.rule: Keep these stable CAL IDs. Reconcile once into the existing tracker after supported recovery; do not create another tracker.

execution.rule: One build/integration owner; other work is disjoint. Do not claim workers are dispatched without actual registration and evidence.
execution.completion_rule: Source proof is complete only for source-level tasks. Runtime-level tasks remain unfinished until runtime_proven; readiness uses the prerequisite task’s own required level.
execution.lane_note: Lanes describe scopes, not spawned agents. Product/scheduling share an engineer; coordination belongs to the commander. Maximum four live agents remains unchanged.
execution.priority_rule: 0 means the next runnable journey, 1 enabling/release work, 2 later full-rollout work. Dependencies and evidence gates always take precedence.
